## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f3194c5140fb7e264cd50c81e3e253b303d2bc0a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0155-sharing-scope-share-grants-lower-to-an-engine-internal-semi-join-leaf.md, docs/adr/README.md + none

PR #34064 for card #33899: one new decision record, ADR-0155 (Status Proposed), and its index row. Reviewed in a context of its own, from the tree at this head, cards #33899 and #33787 with their comments, the PR, and the head's check-runs. Code outside the diff was read on main `e71ecc1b32`, the head's merge base, never reviewed.

**No must-fix.** Three should-fix (S1 to S3) and thirteen nits (N1 to N13), all listed under ④.

### ① Derived judgments

**Gates on this head.** 49 check-runs, all completed, none still running: 26 success, 23 skipped, 0 failed.

- Success: Governed Surface Queue Guard; PR-body guards; Check Changeset; Check PR Size; Check Documentation Links; Auto Label; filter; Plan Test Core shards; Test Core (1/8); Test Core; Test UI; Dogfood Regression Gate; Lint & Repo Gates; Lint · docs & code guards; Lint · repo & tooling gates; Lint · CI, release & engine gates; Lint · ESLint; Lint · PM dispatch-gates; the three Lint · scoped jobs; TypeScript Type Check; Type Check · workspace, source gates, consumer gates and debt ledger.
- Skipped: the UI, build, docs-build, live-database and opt-in jobs, the Dogfood shard matrix and Dogfood Verify CLI, both queue verdicts, the schedule gate, and a second instance each of Auto Label, Check Changeset and Check PR Size.

**The diff.** Net of the merge, the head differs from main in two files: the new record (+673) and `docs/adr/README.md` (+4/−3). The record's blob is the same at the ADR commit `5993103131` and at the head.

**Claims about today's code, each read on `e71ecc1b32`.** All hold. Four are stated loosely and are graded N1, N2, N3 and N12 under ④. Paths are under `packages/`.

- **The capped grant read.** `plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts` L747–756: one `find` of `sys_record_share` with `fields: ['record_id', 'access_level']`, `limit: 5000` and `context: SYSTEM_CTX`. L89: `const SYSTEM_CTX = { isSystem: true, positions: [], permissions: [] } as const;`.
- **The cap fails closed.** The ids that read returns are the only members of the share disjunct (`sharing-service.ts` L770: `disjuncts.push({ id: { $in: grantedIds } })`), and the middleware ANDs the scope into the read's `where` (`sharing-plugin.ts` L1526). A grant past the cap adds no row. On this the record repeats the card's sentence ("past 5,000 share grants a member silently loses access, failing closed") and adds none.
- **Outside the wall.** The security middleware passes a system context through (`plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` L667: `if (opCtx.context?.isSystem)`), and `objectql/src/engine-driver-options.ts#driverReadScope` (L424) projects no tenant scope for a system context that names no organization. No access gate reads a grant row's stamp: in `sharing-service.ts`, `checkEdit` (L1180–1191) and `listShares` (L2305–2310) also read under `SYSTEM_CTX` with no organization predicate.
- **`buildWriteFilter` on update.** `sharing-service.ts` L867: `if (verb === 'delete') return ownerMatch;`. The update read (L869–879) adds `access_level: { $in: [...WRITE_ACCESS_LEVELS] }` at the same `limit: 5000`; `access-level.ts` L67: `WRITE_ACCESS_LEVELS: readonly string[] = ['edit', 'full']`. No approval arm; a phantom anchor answers the deny sentinel (L856). The middleware feeds it to the predicate path only (`sharing-plugin.ts` L1673–1691); the by-id gate reads one record (`limit: 1`, `sharing-service.ts` L1189). A permanent delete dispatches as `purge`, class `delete`; `restore` and the recycle-bin doors carry no AST (`sharing-plugin.ts` L1552). So ③ is one verb on one door, as the record says.
- **The `ReadableIds` leaf.** `spec/src/data/readable-ids.ts` L88: `Symbol.for('objectstack.filter.readableIds')`. `drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-internal-helpers.ts` L136–141: `this.getBuilder(parent).select(this.remoteColumn(parent, 'id', 'id'))`, then `applyTenantScope(sub, parent, options)`, then `applyFilters(sub, leaf.scope, options)`. It projects the parent's `id` under the outer read's tenant scope and has no slot for another column. `objectql/src/filter-comparand-shape.ts` L130: `new Set(['find', 'findOne', 'count', 'aggregate'])`; `engine-update.ts` L439 refuses a leaf in an update's predicate at the executor's entry.
- **Two admitting callers, not one.** The engine door (`objectql/src/filter-comparand-shape.ts` L123) and the analytics merges (`services/service-analytics/src/plugin.ts` L1143, `strategies/objectql-strategy.ts` L1240 and L1785) pass `admitReadableIds: true`.
- **Which drivers run a subquery.** Six drivers ship, and D5 names all six. `driver-sql` compiles (`sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts` L832); `SqliteWasmDriver` and `TursoDriver` extend `SqlDriver`; Turso's remote transport has its own compiler (`remote-transport.ts` L3044); `driver-memory` evaluates in process (`memory-driver.ts` L1490) and refuses tenant-scoped use (`memory-tenancy-guard.ts`); `driver-mongodb` refuses (`mongodb-filter.ts` L1002–1003); `driver-odata` refuses (`odata-driver.ts` L622, called at L290 and L329).
- **The evaluator census.** `formula/src/matches-filter.ts` L716 answers `false` for a non-array `$in` comparand, which is D5's reason for its rule. That matcher's callers on main are the engine's `having` filter, the write tenant wall, the stored RLS check and the explainer; only the explainer is handed the sharing read filter (`explain-engine.ts` L2115, matched through L1720, published as `rowFilter` at L2309). The comment and attachment gates reach it through `security.explain` (`comment-access-hooks.ts` L820, `attachment-access-hooks.ts` L461). `getReadFilter` has no caller on main outside plugin-security, the engine's composition and the analytics service. The analytics native compiler refuses the leaf at entry (`read-scope-sql.ts` L843) and binds one parameter per `$in` member (L2199); the native strategy declines such a query (`native-sql-strategy.ts` L872); `multi-hop` is a shape the engine strategy refuses and only native SQL serves (`cross-object-where.ts` L88 and its header). The sharing service reads `sys_record_share` at six sites, and only L747 and L869 build a list for a scope. I found no evaluator the census misses.
- **The predicate-write bound.** `plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` L926: `PREDICATE_WRITE_READABLE_ID_CAP = MAX_BULK_PER_ROW_HOOK_ROWS`; `spec/src/data/bulk-write-hook-conformance.ts` L282: `MAX_BULK_PER_ROW_HOOK_ROWS = 10_000`; `security-plugin-addressed-writes.ts` reads the cap plus one (L159) and throws past it (L173).
- **The update path under ③ A.** `drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-bulk-operations.ts` L323: `if (query.where) this.applyFilters(builder, query.where, issueOptions);`, the compiler reads use. `engine-update.ts` L947 reads prior rows with the same `ast`.
- **The refusal device.** `core/src/utils/readable-ids-driver-refusal.ts` L208–209: `code = 'INTERNAL_ERROR'`, `status = 500`, logged at `error` once per driver instance.
- **The table.** `plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-record-share.object.ts`: `record_id` is a text pointer (`referenceVia: 'object_name'`, L192); indexes on `(object_name, recipient_type, recipient_id)` and `(object_name, record_id)` (L318, L321). It has no validity, status or soft-delete column, and a `sys_` row's delete is permanent (`spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` L182). So D2's "nothing added" drops no implicit predicate of today's read.
- **The AST `filter` mirror** (plan step 6). `sharing-plugin.ts` L1527 and L1691 write it; the executor boundary judges `where`, `having` and each aggregation's filter (`objectql/src/engine-security-resolvers.ts`), never `filter`.
- **The ADR-0147 seam and the corpus.** ADR-0139 D1 ends "No second leaf, no `EXISTS`, no correlated form" and gives its read-verbs rule no reason; its O4 reads "A separate finding, not this record's". ADR-0147's Status is "Proposed — 2026-11-02"; its D-a has the leaf arrive "already composed"; its D-b says of the wall "Its only lawful effect is redundancy, and anything more changes S". `OrgMemberIds` has no occurrence under `packages/` on main: unbuilt, as the card says. ADR-0111 D10's heading is quoted exactly. AGENTS.md Prime Directive 5 reads as Q2 quotes it. The principle in Q2, 「有的功能如果Mongo内存不支持，那就不需要支持，首先保sql,应该用最高性能的方案，而不能为了兼容而兼容」, is byte-identical to triage comment 6896032788.
- **The cards.** "What it costs" matches 6893239331 item 3 in every number and limit: the scope statements alone, 1M rows, 5,000 grants, PG 21.6 → 7.0 ms, SQLite 18.3 → 12.1 ms, the line-item chain flat, not a whole-request figure. D6's pins match item 2 and ruling 6895275749. D3 follows the correction in 6895112167 ("every arm stays in the same filter").
- **Anchors and links.** All 47 `path#symbol` anchors resolve to a definition at the head, and the file and directory anchors exist. The nine relative links and the eleven in-document fragments resolve.

**The decisions against the card.**

- **Allowed.** D1 is card item 1 (its own brand, the ADR-0147 pattern). D2 restates today's read and leaves the tenant half to ①. D3 is item 6 as 6895112167 corrected it. D4's "Built once" answers item 5, which asked whether. D5's decided rows are the ones item 7's plan builds. D6 is the ruling's pins. Items 2, 4 and 3 are put as ①, ② and ③.
- **One reaches past the card.** D4's refusal for the middleware class (S2).
- **Q1 to Q3 are open in the text.** The Status line names all three as "open for the maintainer" and "not decided by this text". Each Decision sentence that depends on one says so (D-0, D1 Verbs, D2 Tenant scope and the write form, D3, D4, D5, D6). The question section opens "a recommendation is not a decision, and no execution card is cut", and Acceptance criteria hold the cards until the rulings are recorded.
- **Soundness.** D-0 counts in rows, the cap's own unit, and leaves out the evaluators ② covers. D2's blank-id guard is `grantedRecordIds`' filter (`sharing-service.ts` L365–372). D3's "A union of two id sets and an OR of two memberships select the same rows" holds, and an always-present empty subquery admits nothing. D5's rule follows from the matcher line above. The inconsistencies found are S2, N4 and N11.

**PR body requirements, all met.** `Fixes #33899` is line-initial. "Unblocks #33787: that card is `Blocked-by: #33899` (ruling record 6895275749)" names #33787 as blocked by this. `## 维护者速读` lists ①, ② and ③ in Chinese, one line each, under 「需要你做的」. Neither the body nor the record carries a model identifier.

### ② Semver level

None. The diff is two files under `docs/adr/`; no released package moves, so no changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` is the right label (AGENTS.md Post-Task 3: the label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package). Check Changeset: success.

`Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are both line-initial in the PR body, and both are right: the record declares and implements nothing, and no key, value or type an author can write moves. The record says each execution card declares its own Clause-②. The spec card will add a public export and, under ②'s R2 or L, a driver declaration; those cards carry the levels.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Authoring route.** Declared in the claim (6897091687), the PR body and the report (6898513427): the thread is served below the tier `docs/adr/**` mandates, so an isolated `os-dev` subagent pinned to that tier wrote the record on this branch. A served tier cannot be read from the tree, so this is accepted as declared, not verified. This review ran in a separate context and read neither the dispatch order nor the seat's conclusions.
- **The main merge.** The head is the ADR commit `5993103131` (parent `b8ac0e24`) plus merge `f3194c5140` of main `e71ecc1b32`. 40 commits came in by `git rev-list --count`; the report says 32. None touches a code file the record cites. ADR-0139 moved in its Status line and D6 only (PR #33992, `8961c0c3`), which the record does not cite. AGENTS.md moved, and Prime Directive 5 still reads as quoted. The heading "read on `origin/main` `b8ac0e24`" is true as provenance; ① re-read every claim on the merge base.
- **The index.** The README change is the generated row and the counts. Both check against the tree at the head: 156 records, 151 numbers, Proposed 9, and the status rows sum to 156. `scripts/adr-index.mjs` `plainText` strips underscores (L237–243), and ADR-0147's row reads `currentuser.orguserids` on main. That is pre-existing, not this diff's, and rightly left alone. Whether to file it is the seat's call.
- **ADR-0139 untouched, pointer notes owed.** Accepted as declared: the claim set the surface to one record and its index row, two of the five notes, and part of a third, depend on rulings not yet made, and Acceptance criteria hold the notes as owed ("O7's pointer notes land in their own governed edit"). Before acceptance the seat names the card that carries them (the report's open question 1); see N4 and N5. The PR body's "PR #33992 amends its D6 and Status line in flight" is stale: that PR is in this head's base.
- **`driver-memory` left decided.** Sound. Memory evaluates `ReadableIds` in process today, ADR-0139 D3 and ADR-0147 D-d both give it that row, card item 7 builds it, and D5 states the cost of moving it. The principle Q2 quotes names 内存, and neither Q2 nor the 速读 points at the row (N8). The owner seat should put that sentence in front of the maintainer with ②.
- **"50 anchors resolve".** Holds by my own resolution at the head: 47 symbol anchors, each to a definition, and the path anchors exist. With `docs/adr/` I count four path spans; the gate counts its own way. The gate was not re-run here.
- **Tier H.** This record is the seat's contract-tier review. Landing still waits for a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` approval, and the PR is draft.
- **Security.** The record describes the design and the parity rule. On what happens past today's cap it repeats the card's sentence and adds none (TL;DR, "What it costs"). A security item is with the owner seat (S3).

### ④ Design judgment

**Against its first consumer.** The first consumer is the plugin-sharing switch, and it can be written from D1 to D3 as they stand. Every reader of the two builders on main has an answer in the record: the middleware's `where` (D3, D4), the read filter the security service hands to composed `ReadableIds` scopes and to analytics (D4, Q2), the explainer's record pass (Q2), the by-id gates (unchanged; they never see the leaf), and the predicate-write narrowing (a read through the read door, so it takes the read form).

**Against its execution plan.** Spec, engine, `driver-sql` and Turso remote, memory, the rest of the census, then the switch. That is card item 7 with one step added. "It lands last" is right: no producer writes the leaf until every evaluator has an answer for it. The gaps are S1, N9 and N10.

**Clarity, proportion, corpus.** 673 lines and 58.6 KB, against 37.5 KB for ADR-0139 and 37.9 KB for ADR-0147. The difference is the question section (146 lines) and a longer Context (102 lines), and the card's seven items asked for both. Restatement is limited to three places: the SQL in the TL;DR and in D2, the three questions summarised in the Status line and the TL;DR, and four rejections that appear under "Why no existing form serves" and again under Alternatives. ADR-0147 has the same shape. I found no padding. Header fields, anchor style and closing sections follow ADR-0147; the one departure is "Revisits" where ADR-0147 has "Amends" (N5).

**The three recommendations.**

- **Q1.** Both options are costed. B's costs are concrete and check against the code (the driver's tenant predicate has no NULL arm; the stamp can differ from the record's organization, `resolveDirectGrantOrganization`, `sharing-service.ts` L2156–2166), and what B buys is named. Fair.
- **Q2.** Three answers, a census that gives each answer's effect per evaluator, the recommended column's price "stated plainly" (on four storage rows, grants that count today stop counting), "Why not R1 alone", and L's merit said outright: "the one answer under which nothing that works today stops working". The principle is quoted, not paraphrased. Fair.
- **Q3.** A, the three forms of B, and C are each costed, and the fork is real: the engine refuses a leaf on a write verb (`filter-comparand-shape.ts` L130, `engine-update.ts` L439) while `buildWriteFilter` feeds a predicate update. Fair; N13 is the one loose sentence.

**Should-fix.**

- **S1** — D6 and O3: no pin for the caller with no grant. The record makes the share disjunct universal ("As a leaf it is present on every sharing-scoped operation") and prices that in one clause of Consequences ("for a caller with no grant too"). Its one measurement is the R9 figure, taken at 5,000 grants. The statement that changes shape most is the one for a caller with no grant and no queue: today the bare owner match (`sharing-service.ts` L771), after the switch an `$or` with a subquery arm on every list page and total. What to measure is whether the planner still serves that statement from the owner index. D6 pins rows, and O3 measures the grant table's index. Add one pin, on the driver card or the switch card: plan and timing of the list page and its total for a caller with no grant, on SQLite and PostgreSQL, against today's statement. Not measured in this review.
- **S2** — D4 decides one class of ② in place. The other-datasource class is sent to ② ("what it answers is ②"). The middleware class is decided: "the seam refuses the leaf rather than read around the middleware, and every sharing-scoped operation on that host fails until the registration is removed". That is answer R1 for this class whatever ② rules, and Q2's "Why not R1 alone" names that outage as R1's price. ADR-0139 D5.2 is the precedent for the class, and there the refusal was narrower: six consumers kept a bounded probe, and the seventh refuses the one declaration that meets the class, at boot (D5's seventh-consumer note). Here it comes at read time, on every sharing-scoped operation. Under L the up-front substitution could serve the class, since the list is read through the engine and the middleware runs. Under R2 the class could be inert and not an outage. Add the class as a row of Q2's census, or say in D4 why it is decided apart and whether a boot check names the registration. The class is empty in this repository (`hasObjectMiddleware` counts neither a wildcard nor an unscoped registration, and none names `sys_record_share` on main), so the weight sits on O8's census.
- **S3** — O10, read with D1 ("It arrives composed") and D4 ("The engine's door admits this brand the same way"). A security item is with the owner seat. The ask is that O10 is decided in this record and not left to the engine card.

**Nits.**

- **N1** — "What this reading adds", third bullet: the sentence that names a record share among the NOT NULL rows is ADR-0131's TL;DR item 2 and D3 (L99, L386 on main), not D1.
- **N2** — "The read scope": `buildReadFilter` also answers `null` for an object with no schema (`sharing-service.ts` L681; `buildWriteFilter` L837). The list omits that arm.
- **N3** — "The table" and Q1 B: a rule-materialised grant carries its rule's organization only when the rule has one. A platform-global rule's grant "belongs where the record does" (`sharing-service.ts` L2108–2109).
- **N4** — The header's "Revisits" has ADR-0139 D3 move "under one answer to ②", and O7 names the answer: "only under ②'s R2". D4's table says this record consults a driver declaration "under every answer to ② but R1", and Q2's L chooses "from a declaration the driver makes". So the D3 pointer is owed under L as well.
- **N5** — O7's reason is past: PR #33992 is in this head's base. ADR-0147 is still Proposed, and its pointer notes already stand on ADR-0139 (L149 and L198 on main, dated the day of its own Status line) under a header field named "Amends". If the deferral stays, O7 should name the card that carries the notes.
- **N6** — D4 "Built once", the fixed-inner-read row: "one table, one projected column, a closed set of bound equality and membership predicates". ADR-0147's compiled form also carries an outer caller arm and a form with no subquery when no organization is active (its D-a and D-c). The shared description as worded carries neither. Mark them per leaf or widen the row.
- **N7** — D4's second class names object-scoped middleware only. Today's grant read also fires `beforeFind` and `afterFind` hooks registered for `sys_record_share` (`objectql/src/engine-find.ts` L540, L603). None is registered in this repository, and ADR-0139 D5.2 draws the same line, so this is consistent with the corpus. One sentence would close it.
- **N8** — Q2 quotes a principle that names memory and never points at D5's memory row. One line in Q2 would put the decided row where the principle is quoted.
- **N9** — Execution plan step 4 gives `driver-memory` "the in-process evaluation" and names no update path. Step 3 names it for `driver-sql` and Turso ("the update path (③ as ruled)").
- **N10** — D6 pins the top-level position. D4's nested position (the leaf inside a composed `ReadableIds` scope, where today's list "binds once more") and D3's delegated pair have no pin named.
- **N11** — Consequences: "A sharing-scoped operation issues no grant read of its own" and the Freshness sentence about a predicate update hold only under ③ A. Neither says so.
- **N12** — "What this reading adds", second bullet: "It does not evaluate the share arm" reads as if the narrowing knew nothing of shares. The narrowing is a read through the read door (`security-plugin-addressed-writes.ts` L155–165), so the read scope's share arm is in it. What it leaves out is the write scope's arm.
- **N13** — Q3: "each meets a ruling already made". The first form of B is set against a seat constraint (6893239331 item 1), not a ruling. Say which ruling it meets, or call it a constraint.

### ① Derived judgments

**Gates on this head.** 48 check-runs, all completed, none still running: 26 success, 22 skipped, 0 failed.

- Success: Governed Surface Queue Guard; PR-body guards, in both of its runs (the push, and the body edit after it); Check PR Size; Check Documentation Links; Auto Label; filter; Plan Test Core shards; Test Core (1/8); Test Core; Test UI; Dogfood Regression Gate; Lint & Repo Gates; Lint · docs & code guards; Lint · repo & tooling gates; Lint · CI, release & engine gates; Lint · ESLint; Lint · PM dispatch-gates; the three Lint · scoped jobs; TypeScript Type Check; Type Check · workspace, source gates, consumer gates and debt ledger.

**The head.** `1911c32519` merges the fix commit `066925797b` with main `f81e4b6c47`. The fix commit sits on `617f298c4a`, which merges the reviewed head `f3194c5140` with main `27c2f1ea32`. The record's blob is the same at `f3194c5140` and `617f298c4a`, and the same at `066925797b` and this head. The README's blob is the same at all four. So neither merge authored a line of either file, and the round is the fix commit alone: one file, +125/−70, 673 to 728 lines. Net of the merges the head differs from main in the same two files: the record (+728) and `docs/adr/README.md` (+4/−3).

**What moved under the record.** Ten commits reached main between the first record's base `e71ecc1b32` and `f81e4b6c47`. None touches `docs/adr/` or any of the 32 files the record cites, so every reading in the first record stands on this base, and 603 of the record's lines are carried unchanged. This round read the added lines against main, in the sections they sit in. AGENTS.md moved in its governed-surface paragraph. Prime Directive 5 still reads as Q2 quotes it, and the principle in Q2 is still byte-identical to triage comment 6896032788. Main has since moved three more commits, to `385ea1cce5`, which this head has not merged. None touches `docs/adr/`. One cited file is among them, `objectql/src/engine-update.ts`, changed in three lines about currency codes; the refusal the record reads there is unchanged.

**Round 1's findings against the text.** Each is taken, and each fix was checked on main `f81e4b6c47`. Paths are under `packages/`.

Plan step 3 owes it ("D6's reading for a caller with no grant"), and Consequences points at it ("D6 pins that statement's plan and timing"). Today's shape is as the pin says: `plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts` L771 returns the owner match alone when it is the only disjunct.

D4 sends the class to ② ("each is a row of Q2's census"). The TL;DR, D5's list, the Recommendation and plan step 5 follow. The precedent the row cites holds: ADR-0139 D5's seventh-consumer note has the boot refuse the same class and a later registration meet the refusal at read, and `objectql/src/plugin.ts` L1394–1402 is that refusal ("no request is served by a deployment this rejects").
